title: Connect a device
body: Enter the code your TV, display or other device is showing.
filledHelp: Check that this matches the code on the device.
wrong: That code didn't work. Check it against the device: codes last 10 minutes, so the device may show a new one.
required: Enter the code your device is showing.
warnTitle: Only if it's in front of you
warnBody: Allow this only if you started it on a device you can see. If someone sent you this code, choose Deny.
allowedBody: Go back to {{device}}: it's signing in now. You can close this window.
deniedBody: Nothing was shared with it. You can close this window.
